Hi Marcin,

You are right, and I am sorry. The parcel that reached you on October 21 contained the two replacement DC02 boards only. The power supply, the power cable and the 3D printed stand you sent back to us were not in it, so you have no way to power those boards or test them. That is a packing mistake on our side, not anything you did wrong.

A colleague is picking this up today to send the missing parts from our Rotterdam warehouse, free of charge, to the address on your order: the DC02 power supply, the EU power cable and the printed stand. They will confirm it with you by email with the tracking number. If you need two complete sets rather than one, reply here and we will put both in the same parcel.

On the return itself, the parcel on tracking ···· has not been checked in at Rotterdam yet. There is nothing further for you to do, and we will confirm when it lands.

Thank you for your patience, and sorry again for the extra wait this has caused you.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy Support

Hello Marcin,

Yes, and the explanation does not reflect well on us. We asked for the complete set because a warranty unit is checked in and quarantined exactly as it left us, board, power supply, cable and stand together, so the whole set has to come back. The replacement was then raised against the board on its own, because the damage was to the boards, and the warehouse picked only what that line said. Nobody put the two halves of it together before the box went out. That is our mistake, not yours, and it is why you are sitting with two boards you cannot plug in.

What you are owed is the accessory set you sent back: the DC02 power supply, the power cable and the 3D printed stand. A colleague is picking this up today to get them out of our Rotterdam warehouse to you at no cost, and they will confirm here with the tracking number. If you need two full sets rather than one, say so in your reply and both will go in the same parcel.

I am sorry you have had to ask twice, and that you have been without working units since September. Your return parcel, tracking ····, has still not been checked in at Rotterdam, but nothing about this waits on that. There is nothing further needed from you.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy Support
